address: 166 Mu 8, Udon-Nong Khai Road, Mu Mon, Mueang Udon Thani, Udon Thani, 41000, Thailand
bio: A serene pond encircled by wooden pavilions is Majchapasuk's tranquil setting. Each spot in the expansive seating area has a soothing atmosphere, ideal for savouring local seafood steeped in over 40 years of Isan culinary heritage. Standout mains showcase Isan tradition with seabass and snakehead fish. Don't miss the crispy deep-fried spring rolls stuffed with minced pork and pork skin. Evening promises optimum weather conditions and idyllic pond views....
